Definition: Nachath, the name of an Edomite and of two Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Nahath = "rest"; 1) one of the dukes of Edom, son of Reuel and grandson of Esau; 2) a Kohathite Levite, son of Zophai and grandson of Elkanah; 3) an Levite overseer in the time of Hezekiah
